instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.label: free androgen index
items.definition: Quantification of abnormal androgen status in humans, calculated as the ratio of the total level of testosterone divided by the SHBG level, multiplied by a constant (usually 100)

items.label: ticagrelor measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of ticagrelor in a sample. Ticagrelor is a platelet aggregation inhibitor used for the prevention of thrombotic events in people with acute coronary syndrome or myocardial infarction with ST elevation.

items.label: allergy measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of an allergy, for example whether an allergy is present or its severity. Allergies are commonly quantified through measurement of allergen-specific IgE in the blood or skin reaction after puncture of skin through a droplet of allergen extract (skin prick test)

items.label: drug use measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of drug use, such as whether drug use occured, over what period of time it occured and what dosage was used

items.label: SSRI use measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of SSRI use
synonyms: selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor use measurement

items.label: NSAID use measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of NSAID use

items.label: aspirin use measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of aspirin use

items.label: food allergy measurement
items.definition: quantification of the presence or severity of an allergy to some food

items.label: peanut allergy measurement
items.definition: quantification of the presence or severity of an allergy to peanuts

items.label: egg allergy measurement
items.definition: quantification of the presence or severity of an allergy to eggs

items.label: milk allergy measurement
items.definition: quantification of the presence or severity of an allergy to milk or other dairy products

items.label: seropositivity measurement
items.definition: a seropositivity measurement is the quantification of an individual's exposure to a certain pathogen through the presence or absence in blood of pathogen specific circulating antibodies

items.label: Chlamydia pneumoniae seropositivity
items.definition: Chlamydia pneumoniae seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating C. pneumoniae specific antibodies

items.label: herpes virus seropositivity
items.definition: herpes virus seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating herpes virus specific antibodies

items.label: cytomegalovirus seropositivity
items.definition: cytomegalovirus seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating cytomegalovirus specific antibodies

items.label: Influenza A seropositivity
items.definition: Influenza A seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating Influenza A specific antibodies

items.label: human herpesvirus 8 seropositivity
items.definition: human herpesvirus 8 seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating human herpesvirus 8 specific antibodies

items.label: polychlorinated biphenyls measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of some polychlorinated biphenyls, a group of man-made environmental pollutants which accumulate in humans with adverse health effects

items.label: executive function
items.definition: A set of mental processes that controls and manages the cognitive functions.

items.label: Toxoplasma gondii seropositivity
items.definition: Toxoplasma gondii seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating T. gondii specific antibodies. T. gondii is a parasitic protozoan that causes toxoplasmosis

items.label: human herpesvirus 6 seropositivity
items.definition: human herpesvirus 6 seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating human herpesvirus 6 specific antibodies

items.label: gliadin seropositivity
items.definition: gliadim seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating  antibodies specific to the food antigen gliadin

items.label: HSV1 seropositivity
items.definition: HSV1 seropositivity is the result of a measurement of circulating herpes simplex virus type 1 specific antibodies

items.label: microsatellite instability measurement
items.definition: quantification of microsatellite instability

items.label: clinical treatment
items.definition: Where a drug or surgery has been used to treat an individual with a particular condition.

items.label: miotic rate
items.definition: A measure of how fast cancer cells are dividing and growing. To find the mitotic rate, the number of cells dividing in a certain amount of cancer tissue is counted. items.label: last follow up
items.definition: The date or time of the last check of a patient by a medical professional.

items.label: germplasm
items.definition: Germplasm is the living genetic resources such as seeds or tissue that is maintained for the purpose of animal and plant breeding, preservation, and other research uses. These resources may take the form of seed collections stored in seed banks, trees growing in nurseries, animal breeding lines main

items.label: Weiss grade
items.definition: Grade of adrenocortical carcinoma based on the scoring system of Weiss (Weiss LM. Comparative histologic study of 43 metastasizing and nonmetastasizing adrenocortical tumors. Am J Surg Pathol 1984;8:163-9.)

items.label: passage number
items.definition: The number of times a cell culture has been passaged (sub-cultured or split).

items.label: tumor mass
items.definition: The mass of a tumor.

items.label: organism status
items.definition: The stage premortem or postmortem at which the sample was processed for extraction of biomaterials. (from MGED ontology MO_871).

items.label: Sasang constitutional medicine type
items.definition: one of four constitutional types used to classify individuals in traditional Korean medicine

items.label: Tae-Yang
items.definition: Constitutional type in traditional Korean medicine. Individuals classed under this type are supposed to have large lungs and a small liver. They have superiority in function, and are born with inferiority.

items.label: So-Yang
items.definition: Constitutional type in traditional Korean medicine. Individuals classed under this type are supposed to have a large spleen, and small kidneys. They have whitish skin. Like So-Eum, many of this type are skinny.

items.label: Tae-Eum
items.definition: Constitutional type in traditional Korean medicine. Individuals classed under this type are supposed to have  have a large liver and small lungs. They are tall and the majority gain a lot of weight. They are patient and have a reserved personality. Therefore, if they are given a task, they will not

items.label: So-Eum
items.definition: Constitutional type in traditional Korean medicine. Individuals classed under this type are supposed to have large kidneys and a small spleen. They are short and many are skinny. Due to weak intestines, they very often have digestive problem. Many enjoy a meat diet.

items.label: experimental stage
items.definition: An experimental stage is spatiotemporal region encompassing some part of a scientic experimental process; e.g. primary, or secondary.

items.label: high content screening stage
items.definition: An experimental stage describing stages of high content screen analysis

items.label: primary high content screen
items.definition: an initial, exploratory screen

items.label: secondary high content screen
items.definition: a screen to investigate further potential genes or phenotypes of interest.  This screen may target orthologous genes in another species.

items.label: validation high content screen
items.definition: a screen to check whether the results in another screen are reproducible.  Usually a different reagent targetting genes of interest are used.

items.label: HCS protocol
items.definition: A protocol which describes a part of the process in performing a High Content Screen experiment

items.label: HCS library protocol
items.definition: A protocol which provides instructions on how to create the library used in an High Content Screen experiment.

items.label: HCS image acquistion and feature extraction protocol
items.definition: A protocol which provides instructions on how to obtain images and extract features from the images in an High Content Screen experiment.
synonyms: high content screen image acquistion and feature extraction protocol
high content screening image acquistion and feature extraction protocol

items.label: HCS data analysis protocol
items.definition: A protocol which provides instructions on how to analyse or interpret the results from images or feature profiles in a High Content Screen experiment
synonyms: high content screen data analysis protocol
high content screening data analysis protocol

items.label: bone mineral accretion measurement
items.definition: quantification of the accruel of bone mineral density over time

items.label: chromatid break measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the level of DNA strand breaks in a cell, for example induced by an antineoplastic agent such a bleomycin. Chromatid breaks can be assessed under the microscope in dividing cells during metaphase.

items.label: total ventricular volume measurement
items.definition: quantification of the total volume of a brain's four ventricles, usuallly through an MRI scan

items.label: asthma exacerbation measurement
items.definition: quantification of acute asthma exacerbations in an individual, generally defined by short courses of treatment with medication such as oral steroids.

items.label: volumetric bone mineral density
items.definition: quantification of the mineral mass per unit volume of bone, generally expressed in grams per cubic centimeter or per ml. This is not to be confused with bone mineral density as calculated per unit area of bone (grams per square centimeter), which is the definition most commonly used in clinical prac

items.label: bone mineral content measurement
items.definition: quantification of the form or content of one or more of the mineral components of bone

items.label: sRAGE measurement
items.definition: quantification in a plasma sample of the levels of soluble Receptor for Advanced Glycation End-products (sRAGE). sRAGE is a strong markers of vascular outcomes
synonyms: soluble receptor for advanced glycation end-products measurement

items.label: asthenia
items.definition: Clinical sign or symptom manifested as debility, or lack or loss of strength and energy.

items.label: emphysema imaging measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect, eg the presence/absence or severity of emphysema through the use of imaging techniques such as CT scans

items.label: airway imaging measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the size of or level of damage to a person's airways using medical imaging techniques such as CT scans. This approach is used in the diagnosis and assessment of respiratory disorders such as COPD and emphysema

items.label: gas trapping measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of air that is abnormally retained in the lungs at the end of an exhalation.

items.label: hemoglobin A1 measurement
items.definition: Hemoglobin A1 measurement is a measure of the quantity of the metallo protein hemoglobin A. Hemoglobin A (HbA), also known as adult hemoglobin or a2b2, is the most common human hemoglobin tetramer, comprising over 97% of the total red blood cell hemoglobin. items.label: hexose measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of the monosaccharide hexose in a sample, typically in blood

items.label: concentration dose ratio
items.definition: Quantification of the metabolism rate of drugs such as psychotropic drugs, defined as the quotient of a drug's serum concentration (in nmol/L) by its prescribed daily dosage (in mg/day). This measure can also be standardised to allow comparison across multiple drugs by dividing individual CDR values

items.label: traditional Chinese medicine type
items.definition: one of several constitutional types used to classify individuals in traditional Chinese medicine

items.label: Yu-Zhi constitution type
items.definition: One of the constitution types used in TCM. The Yu-Zhi (YZ) constitution in TCM indicates stasis and stagnation, which expressed dull, lusterless skin color; dry, cracked, scaly or tough skin; dull purple lips or tongue; localized pain or numb- ness; knotted, intermittent, or uneven pulse. items.label: minimal erythema dose
items.definition: quantification of an individual's sensitity to UV radiation, defined as the shortest exposure to ultraviolet radiation that produces reddening of the skin within 1 to 6 hr and disappears in 24 hr

items.label: longitudinal alcohol consumption measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of alcohol consumption over a long period of time (typically several years)

items.label: vancomycin trough measurement
items.definition: quantification of the lowest concentration of vancomycin in a patient's blood during the course of treatment. Trough measurements are used to calculate the rate of absorption of the drug and determine the optimum time for administering the next dose

items.label: renal elimination rate measurement
items.definition: quantification of the rate at which the kidneys eliminate a substance from the blood stream

items.label: health trait
items.definition: The characteristics in health that a certain person has.

items.label: clinical ideal cardiovascular health
items.definition: the characteristics of a person's cardiovascular health based on a number of factors including cholesterol levels in the absence of treatment, blood pressure and diabetes status

items.label: clinical and behavioural ideal cardiovascular health
items.definition: the characteristics of a person's cardiovascular health based on a number of factors including cholesterol levels in the absence of treatment, blood pressure, diabetes status, BMI and smoking status

items.label: clusterin measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of the glycoprotein clusterin in a sample. Clusterin is also known as apolipoprotein J and plays a role in several cellular processes including apoptosis, proliferation, and clearance of misfolded proteins

items.label: carrier status
items.definition: quantification of the presence or absence of a marker, eg a gene or a substance, in a sample

items.label: APOE carrier status
items.definition: quantification of the presence or absence of apolipoprotein E (APOE) in an individual

items.label: neuroticism measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of neuroticism or neurotic behaviour, such as severity or frequency of neurotic behaviour. This is usually assessed via a standardised questionnaire.

items.label: outer ear morphology trait
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the fine, keratinized filamentous growths arising from the epidermis of mammals.

items.label: ear protrusion
items.definition: the physical distance from the outer edge of the outer ear to the head

items.label: lobe size
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical magnitude of the soft tissue at the base of the outer ear; consists of fat and fibrous tissue not reinforced by the auricular cartilage.

items.label: lobe attachment
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the physical attachment of the soft tissue at the base of the outer ear to the head. items.label: tragus size
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the size of the tragus, a small pointed eminence of the external ear, situated in front of the concha, and projecting backward over the meatus

items.label: antitragus size
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the size of the antitragus, a feature of human ear anatomy. It is a small tubercle that points anteriorly. It is separated from the tragus by the intertragic notch.

items.label: helix rolling
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape and structure of the helix, the outer rim of the ear. The border of the helix usually forms a rolled rim but it is highly variable in shape.

items.label: folding of antihelix
items.definition: Any measurable or observable characteristic related to the shape and structure of the antihelix, a Y-shaped curved cartilaginous ridge arising from the antitragus and separating the concha, triangular fossa, and scapha. items.label: superior crus of antihelix expression

items.label: Darwin's tubercule
items.definition: a congenital ear condition which often presents as a thickening on the helix at the junction of the upper and middle thirds.

items.label: metastasis measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of cancer metastases, incl presence/abscence, size, location or origin

items.label: LDL peak particle diameter measurement
items.definition: peak distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of blood-derived low-density lipoprotein (LDL) particles
synonyms: low density lipoprotein peak particle diameter measurement

items.label: total fat intake measurement
items.definition: quantification of the total amount of dietary fat consumed by an individual

items.label: surgical shock
items.definition: A type of shock that occurs as a result of a surgical procedure.

items.label: GBA carrier status
items.definition: quantification of the presence or absence of a mutation in the gene for Glucocerebrosidase (GBA) in an individual

items.label: exploratory eye movement measurement
items.definition: quantification of a participant’s eye tracking while viewing stationary S-shaped figures

items.label: spine bone mineral density
items.definition: mineral density of the spine bones

items.label: hip bone mineral density
items.definition: mineral density of the hip bone

items.label: hystidil-tRNA synthetase autoantibody measurement
items.definition: quantification in a sample of autoantibodies against hystidil-tRNA synthetase, an enzyme which in humans is encoded by the HARS gene

items.label: cognitive decline measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of cognitive decline such as the rate at which it occurs or its severity, for example in patients with dementia or Alzheimer's disease. Cognitive decline is ususally assessed using a structured-interview protocol covering a number of standardised areas.

items.label: carotid artery central pulse pressure measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the central pulse pressure in the carotid artery

items.label: carotid artery mean blood pressure measurement
items.definition: Quantification of mean blood pressure in the carotid artery

items.label: influenza A severity measurement
items.definition: quantification of the severity of an infection with the influenza type A virus

items.label: lung disease severity measurement
items.definition: quantification of the severity of lung disease, eg cystic fibrosis, through comparison of an individual's FEV1 score to the average age-specific percentile values of FEV1 for each patient in a study

items.label: lactate measurement
items.definition: quantification of lactate in a sample

items.label: white matter lesion progression measurement
items.definition: quantification of the progression of lesions in white matter of the brain using magnetic resonance imaging
